[#reference-commands]
== Command reference

Every command, taken from the registry. `ws-host command list` and `ws-host command show ID` say the same thing, and `ws-host help` is where the daily work is explained.

=== auth

[cols="3,1,2,5"]
|===
|Usage |Category |Where it runs |What it does

|`ws-host auth new FORGE [--host STRING]`
|setup
|terminal, editor
|Sign in to GitHub or GitLab with a one-time code

|`ws-host auth status`
|read
|terminal, editor, mcp
|Say whether you are signed in to GitHub and GitLab

|===

|build

=== kit

[cols="3,1,2,5"]
|===
|Usage |Category |Where it runs |What it does

|`ws-host kit add KIT`
|setup
|terminal
|Install a kit (uses sudo for packages, and says so first)

|`ws-host kit list`
|read
|terminal, editor, mcp
|List the kits and which are installed

|`ws-host kit show KIT`
|read
|terminal, editor, mcp
|Show what a kit installs on this machine

|===

=== repo

[cols="3,1,2,5"]
|===
|Usage |Category |Where it runs |What it does

|`ws-host repo add [REPO] [--all] [--trust]`
|setup
|terminal
|Copy missing repositories to this machine

|`ws-host repo advance [REPO] [--all]`
|setup
|terminal
|Bring repositories up to date, never touching your work

|`ws-host repo list`
|read
|terminal, editor, mcp
|List the repositories I know

|`ws-host repo set REPO [--trusted] [--untrusted]`
|decision
|terminal, editor
|Trust or stop trusting a repository's code

|`ws-host repo status [REPO]`
|read
|terminal, editor, mcp
|Show the state of one or all repositories

|===

=== vscode

[cols="3,1,2,5"]
|===
|Usage |Category |Where it runs |What it does

|`ws-host vscode add`
|setup

=== workspace

[cols="3,1,2,5"]
|===
|Usage |Category |Where it runs |What it does

|`ws-host workspace advance`
|setup
|terminal, editor
|Install your kits, check sign-in, copy missing repositories, update the rest, set up the editor, check health

|`ws-host workspace set [--pull-ff-only]`
|setup
|terminal, editor
|Make git's Sync button safe: set pull.ff to only

|`ws-host workspace status`
|read
|terminal, editor, mcp
|Say how this machine and your repositories stand

=== (no noun: the repository-wide commands)

[cols="3,1,2,5"]
|===
|Usage |Category |Where it runs |What it does

|`ws-host check [SECTIONS...] [--suite SECTION]`
|check
|terminal, editor, mcp
|Run the checks of this repository

|`ws-host context [RESOURCE]`
|read
|terminal, editor, mcp
|Everything needed to get help with this machine, with secrets removed

|`ws-host doctor`
|check
|terminal, editor, mcp
|Check what ws-host needs and what is present

|`ws-host fresh [GENERATORS...]`
|check
|terminal, editor, mcp
|Prove the generated files are current

|`ws-host help [TOPIC]`
|read
|terminal, editor, mcp
|Learn how to do the daily work, one topic at a time

|`ws-host test`
|check
|terminal, editor, mcp
|Run this repository's tests

|===

A `decision` command is for a person: it is never offered over MCP, and the editor asks you in a dialog.
